name: Draggable horizontal review carousel with reply cards
notes: Reviews are fabricated for this library — de-identified from the original client build and rewritten as fake, generic testimonials (swap in the target business's own real reviews before reuse). The reply line under each card — owner responding by name — is the standout trust device here; worth reusing even without the carousel. Horizontal scroll uses a CSS mask to fade the edges instead of hard-clipping cards; JS drag-to-scroll (grab/grabbing cursor) not included but the CSS supports it as pure scroll-snap too.
